title: hibp-interoperability-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.risk.hibp-check, identity.password.signup, identity.password.set, identity.password.change, identity.password.reset-complete, identity.admin.user-password-set; exact inputs: range_endpoint, password_sha1_prefix, user_agent, follow_redirects, add_padding_header, padded_response, provider_outcome, password_operation; initial state: pinned HIBP range fixtures contain separately attributable known-compromised and absent/no-match padded responses plus malformed, redirect, unavailable, and unknown outcomes for every password credential creation, change, reset, and administrative set path

stimulus.const: Run identity.risk.hibp-check then identity.password.signup then identity.password.set then identity.password.change then identity.password.reset-complete then identity.admin.user-password-set for success, failure, outage cases using range_endpoint, password_sha1_prefix, user_agent, follow_redirects, add_padding_header, padded_response, provider_outcome, password_operation and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: both known-compromised and absent/no-match cases send only a five-uppercase-hex prefix to the exact HTTPS range endpoint with a nonsecret User-Agent, redirects disabled, Add-Padding true, and zero password or full-hash disclosure; the compromised case proves a positive suffix match while the absent case proves exactly zero matches; unavailable or unknown evidence makes signup, set, change, reset, and administrative set deny or return unavailable and never allow; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, outage=unavailable/unavailable; required artifact fields: range_endpoint, transmitted_prefix, user_agent, user_agent_secret_match_count, redirect_follow_count, add_padding_header, padding_row_count, padded_response_valid, outcome_cases, known_compromised_match_count, absent_match_count, unavailable_case_count, unknown_case_count, password_signup_denied, password_set_denied, password_change_denied, password_reset_denied, admin_password_set_denied, timeout_status, response_digest

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: both known-compromised and absent/no-match cases send only a five-uppercase-hex prefix to the exact HTTPS range endpoint with a nonsecret User-Agent, redirects disabled, Add-Padding true, and zero password or full-hash disclosure; the compromised case proves a positive suffix match while the absent case proves exactly zero matches; unavailable or unknown evidence makes signup, set, change, reset, and administrative set deny or return unavailable and never allow; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, outage=unavailable/unavailable; required artifact fields: range_endpoint, transmitted_prefix, user_agent, user_agent_secret_match_count, redirect_follow_count, add_padding_header, padding_row_count, padded_response_valid, outcome_cases, known_compromised_match_count, absent_match_count, unavailable_case_count, unknown_case_count, password_signup_denied, password_set_denied, password_change_denied, password_reset_denied, admin_password_set_denied, timeout_status, response_digest

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/hibp-interoperability-report.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/hibp-interoperability-report.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest
